comment: Every command in `opens` opens a PR in the stub (gh pr create/new, or a gh api POST to a pulls collection / createPullRequest). With pr-open-gate removed from the config, each must be refused by permissions.ask. Every `controls` command must run unasked: it cannot open a PR (round 3 narrowed the gh api rules to PR-creating calls). prompt.md is generated from this file by tests/test_pr_open_gate.py::test_ask_coverage_prompt_lists_the_battery.
opens: if true; then gh pr create --fill; fi
gh api repos/acme/widget/pulls -f title=t -f head=feat/retry-backoff -f base=main
echo a#b; gh api repos/acme/widget/pulls -f title=t
gh api graphql -f query='mutation { createPullRequest(input:{}) { clientMutationId } }'
